note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list as published on Exophase and PSNProfiles and cross-checked by Planet GTA 6. Guides are this site's own words; each cites its sources.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: it pops the moment the other 54 are earned.
trophies.guide: This is the last trophy you will earn. It pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are unlocked, so there is nothing to do for it directly — no online play and no DLC is needed. In practice the final one is usually A Long Road (100% completion), so plan your cleanup around that. One warning for the whole run: turning on a cheat disables trophies and saving, so keep cheats off until the platinum is yours.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: it is the first main mission.
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, and the first one most players will earn. Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 — it is a gentle introduction, mostly following on-screen prompts and learning the fishing controls — and finish it; the trophy pops when the mission ends. There is nothing to prepare and nothing to miss: if a mission step fails, retry it from the pause menu and carry on.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: story progress only.
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish every main mission of Chapter 1 and the trophy pops as the chapter closes — it unlocks when the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, begins. No side content is needed for it, and no mission can be skipped: just follow the story markers on the map in order. Use Chapter 1 to learn the habits that pay off later — scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals through the binoculars as you travel.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: story progress only.
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Play through Chapter 2 to the end and it pops when Chapter 3 opens with the mission Welcome to Vice City. Chapter 2 is where the game opens up: after the mission Coffee Break you can switch between Jason and Lucia and free-roam together, which unlocks several other trophies — so take your time here and pick up the optional missions (purple icons) as they appear. The asterisks in the name are part of the official trophy name.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: story progress only.
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Chapter 3; it pops once you have completed the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Chapter 3 is a good moment to start the side questlines that feed other trophies — Andy's quests for Lucia, Kenton's treasure diving, Randy's car wish list — since they stay available after the story anyway, there is no rush, just keep playing the story markers in order.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: story progress only.
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the final main mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero, and the trophy pops as Chapter 4 closes. Chapter 4 also holds several of the named mission trophies — Child's Play, Headliners and VCIA Takedown — so by the time this one pops you will have collected those too. Nothing optional is needed for it.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: story progress only.
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy and the only gold tied to the story. Finish the game's final mission and it pops — this is the end of the story, not the end of the platinum. After it, free-roam stays open, so every other trophy can still be earned: the 100% checklist, the collectibles, the robberies and the activity grinds are all still there. If you did the one missable meditation in Chapter 1 for Positive Mental Attitude, nothing can lock you out from here.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: story mission in Chapter 2.
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run — just follow the story marker and play it through; it pops when the mission ends. It unlocks as part of normal story progress, so no side content is needed, and it is one of the earlier named-mission trophies on the road to the Chapter 2 completion trophy.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: story mission in Chapter 3.
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist — follow the story marker, play the heist through, and the trophy pops when the mission ends. It is a set-piece mission, so expect a longer playtime than a normal story mission; if you fail a step, the mission restarts from its latest checkpoint and the trophy still pops on completion.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: story mission in Chapter 4.
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play and it pops when the mission ends. Like the other named-mission trophies it needs nothing but story progress — no collectibles, no side quests, no particular way of finishing the mission. Keep following the Chapter 4 story markers and it comes on its own.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: story mission in Chapter 4.
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners and it pops when the mission ends. The name is stylised — DWNFALL, no vowels — and it is one of three named-mission trophies in Chapter 4, alongside Family Matters and Hi-Jacked. Story progress only; nothing optional is needed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: story mission in Chapter 4.
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown — the airport takedown — and it pops when the mission ends. It is the last of Chapter 4's named-mission trophies before the chapter closes with Starting From Zero. No side content or special approach is needed; finish the mission any way you like.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: story mission in Chapter 5.
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory and it pops when the mission ends. Chapter 5 is the final chapter, so this is one of the last story trophies before the final mission — after it, the story wraps up quickly and free-roam opens for the whole cleanup phase of the platinum.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: the checklist opens after the story and everything in it stays doable in free-roam.
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy and the usual last one. After the story, the 100% checklist opens under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — progress you made during the story already counts toward it. The requirements are forgiving, closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not needed, and of the collectibles only part is required. The categories that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. You need any 70 of the 80 challenges, any 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, and any 100 of the 255 animals studied through binoculars. Work on it after the story, in free-roam, one category at a time.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: stunts stay available in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps with a parachute — mix them however you like. Flying under bridges is the quickest to grind. For 100% completion you need 300 stunts, so keep going past 250. Track progress under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and see each stunt by name on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: every activity stays available after the story.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your progress under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities — scrolling over each type shows how many you have done. Most types are introduced by the story or marked with blue dumbbell icons on the map, and you will do most of them naturally while chasing the other trophies.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: ranges stay open after the story.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges, spread across 12 shooting range locations. Gold medals are not brutally hard — take your time, aim for the head, and replay a challenge until the gold threshold is met. All 42 golds are also required for 100% completion, so this is not optional work for the platinum. Use this guide's target counter to track how many golds you have, and do a few ranges each session rather than all 42 in one sitting.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: drone races stay available after the story.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. There are 42 drone races in total across those locations, but only one win per location is needed for this trophy. Learn each course's corners, cut them tight, and retry a location until you win — drone races are also part of the 100% checklist, so they count twice toward the platinum.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: races stay available after the story.
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the same race twice does not count twice. There are 40 unique race locations, so you have twice as many to choose from as you need. Pick the short, easy circuits first, use a fast car you are comfortable with, and work through the list until 20 are ticked off.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: Cal's fishing questline stays available after the story.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will send a text message that marks a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him in his fishing challenge. Fishing itself is one of the 9 activity types, so this also feeds Master of None.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: arcade games stay playable after the story.
trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the 4 arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home by interacting with the controllers, from Chapter 1 onward; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game — beating every challenge inside it is not required. Pick the game you like best and play it through.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: Andy's quests stay available after the story.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's optional questline, which is exclusive to Lucia. It is marked automatically in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then she texts her home address, marking the questline in Belville. Complete her 5 quests in order — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (the Cellerica initiation), Read the Label (retrieve the Cellerica van) and Puff Puff Pass (meet at the warehouse). The last one pops the trophy, and the whole line can still be done after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: Kenton returns in Chapters 2-3 and his quests stay available after the story.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's optional questline. It is marked automatically in Chapter 1: a while after the mission Island Dreams (work for Kenton), he calls you and is then marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you treasure diving — he marks purple treasure chest icons on the map, you find the underwater treasures (use the metal detector to dig them from the ocean floor) and bring them back. In total he wants 7 shipwrecks cleared. Track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees, or Progress, then Collections, then Kenton's Treasures. Kenton goes quiet for a while after Chapter 1, but he comes back in Chapters 2-3 — as Jason you can speed it up by calling Brian — so do not worry if he vanishes for a bit.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: Billy's quests stay available after the story.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's optional questline. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his 5 quests — Thrillbillies (check out the mud club), Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab (join Billy on a job), Mall Rats (join Billy on a job), The Impaler (steal the Impaler) and Hometown Heroes (join Billy on a job). The last one pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: strangers stay in the world after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands. Careful: only certain questlines count toward this trophy — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count, even though they are side quests. The strands confirmed to count are Kirk (the Skunk Ape quests: Skunk Apeology 101, searching for tree effigies, and Advanced Skunk Apeonomics), Kyle (McKittrick Farm, collecting chemicals, checking on Kyle), Yago (joining a street race, mentoring him, racing him, backing him up) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile quests and his package deliveries). You can find them all after the story in free-roam, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows how many you have finished.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: Randy's wish list stays available after the story.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's optional questline, Randy's Wish List. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. He then gives you a list of 16 sports cars he wants — the Granforma Zorrusso is already delivered during that mission, and the rest (Pegassi Vitello, Infernus and Toros, Buckingham Windsor Drop and Jubilee, and others) can be stolen off the street or from the spots he marks. Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is on the list, then drive it back to his garage — he is marked by the green RK icon in the west of Vice City, and cars delivered in good condition pay more. Track the list under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List. Delivering the last car pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: Tyrone's quests stay available after the story.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's optional questline, which is only available as Jason. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City. Go to the labs and destroy them as part of Take Out Kitty Litter. After you have destroyed enough labs, Tyrone gives his second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down — completing it pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: POTENTIALLY MISSABLE — the first meditation, at Jason's house in Chapter 1, is only available during Chapter 1. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. It is not yet confirmed whether this one is required for the trophy, so do it to be safe.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots, spread across 10 locations. You can meditate with both Lucia and Jason at each spot, which counts as +2 at the same location, and you cannot do the final meditation until you can play both characters together (after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break). Track them under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. WARNING — the one missable moment in the whole platinum: during Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen at Jason's house one morning and walks out to the balcony. Follow her, talk to her on the balcony and choose Accept so she shows you how to meditate. This meditation raises the counter by 1 in the Progress menu but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the others, and it becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1. It is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy — do it anyway, while you still can. For 100% completion only 15 of the 18 spots are needed, so the checklist is safe either way.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: Bret's quests stay available after the story.
trophies.guide: Finish Bret Vogel's hunting questline, which is exclusive to Jason. It is marked at some point after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text message from Bret that marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County (Lucia cannot receive the message). After that he marks hunting spots with purple icons on the map — hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him as Jason. During his first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nations. One clean shot leaves an animal in pristine condition and pays more, but it is not required. Track the hunts under Map, then Activities, then Target Deck — there are 15 Target Decks in total, and all 15 are needed for 100% completion, so you will earn this naturally along the way.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: cards stay findable after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card sets in total across Leonida, so you only need a sixth of them for this trophy — pick the sets whose cards are clustered together and grab those first. Cards are found in the world, often tucked into shops, houses and other interiors, so check the map and your collection progress as you go. For 100% completion you need 15 of the 18 sets, so this trophy is an early milestone on a much longer hunt — use this guide's target counter to track sets as you finish them.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: WAiNK scans stay available after the story.
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK phone app: hold Up and then R1 while looking at an object in the world. There are more than 100 scannable spots, so it does not matter which 100 you pick — the counts break down as 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher Tags. Make scanning a habit while you travel: every new vehicle and landmark you pass is one more toward the total, and it feeds the vehicle and exploration goals at the same time.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: challenges stay available after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges, in eight groups of ten. View and track them under Progress, then Challenges — a checkmark in the bottom right when you scroll over a challenge shows it is done. Many complete themselves naturally while you work on the other trophies and the 100% checklist, and for 100% you need any 70 of the 80, so this trophy pops on the way. Leave it for late, then pick the easiest and quickest of your remaining challenges.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: wanted levels can be raised again any time after the story.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape the red heat zone. The earliest you can do it is after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam together as Jason and Lucia — call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Cause carnage until you reach 4 stars, then escape on a fast sports motorcycle, cutting through traffic; if a helicopter chases you, shoot at it until it leaves. An easy escape route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — the cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you there. The trophy pops after you drive out of the red heat wanted zone, not when you leave the flashing search area. It also comes automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since robbing large bank vaults always gives a 4-star wanted level you must escape.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: shop robberies can be repeated any time after the story.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while keeping your wanted level the whole time — do not lose the cops between shops. You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters; call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Hit 3 robbery targets (green icons on the map) while being chased, and keep the red-and-blue flashing wanted level going — not the red heat level. Bring an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, plus Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: rob a couple of items in each store, ideally go into the back room and break the safe with sticky bombs, and if the trophy does not pop after the third shop, hit a fourth and keep going. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the third shop.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: vehicles keep appearing after the story.
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. GTA VI has 557 vehicles at launch — cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes. The fastest way is the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up to open it instantly): look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. Scanning is enough, you do not need to drive it. Stand at a busy road and scan everything that passes. For 100% completion you need to scan 200 of the base-model vehicles, so this trophy comes automatically. Check your totals under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: Combat Focus can be used again any time.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm — time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar at the top left under your health and stamina. First, raise your focus: eat or drink, wash your face or shower at home, and consume Adrenaline (hold L1, then press Triangle) to stretch the slow-motion window. Then line up 5 enemies — criminals at gang operations are ideal — and drop them quickly without missing. Wear body armor from Ammu-Nation so you can step out of cover and get close, and use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556 rather than a pistol or SMG. The trophy does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. It gets easier as your focus levels up — there are 4 levels, raised by shooting range challenges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — so you may well earn it naturally by the endgame.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: VCIA planes stay stealable after the story.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) and take off in it. It must be a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge — the ones parked on the airfield do not work. The easiest is the plane at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head straight for it, and next to the boarding bridge there are stairs with a door leading directly into the plane. Inside, go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip and take off. The pop is a little delayed — you must fly about 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport before it unlocks.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: the tanks stay at the air station after the story.
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — a Rhino — and use it. The tanks are at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, standing in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate or use the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy pops. Expect soldiers to fight back once you are inside, so keep moving and use the cannon; the trophy pops from using the tank, not from a set number of kills.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: jewelry store robberies can be repeated after the story.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. That unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and unlocks jewelry store robberies, marked automatically with green icons in unfogged map areas. Break into a jewelry store through the back door using the Snap Gun — the gadget stays in your inventory permanently, no need to equip it. When you approach a locked door you get a prompt to kick it (which triggers the alarm) or use the Snap Gun for the stealth approach. Inside, go to the back room, look for a note with the safe code, and use the code to loot the safe. A good location is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: bank vault robberies stay available after the story.
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress and introduces bank vault robberies: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, watch a guard carry a briefcase of cash in and open the vault, then slip in while it is open and rob it. You cannot carry all the cash yourself — bring your partner and hold Right to hand off one bag. After that quest you can pay Yasmani (the fence unlocked in Chapter 3) for tips about security vans; if you have not done his earlier quests yet, do those first (robbing 2 Payday Loans), then he sells van tips for $10,000 and marks the vans with a purple icon. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. There are 8 large bank jobs in total, and 100% completion needs all 8, so you will earn this automatically. Each bank pays up to $205,000, making this the best money-maker in the endgame.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: armored trucks keep driving around after the story.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easiest way is automatic: the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (the same one that unlocks bank vault robberies) counts as robbing an armored truck, since you tail the truck to the bank and rob its vault. You need all 8 large bank jobs for 100% completion anyway, so this pops on its own. To get it earlier, find an armored truck driving around Vice City near banks, block its path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open — then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after doing his jobs; Yasmani is unlocked as a fence from the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: the map stays open after the story.
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida — all 52 areas. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every part of the map still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible. Do it in one focused session after the story, sweeping county by county, rather than in drips. Fly low over the coastline and the islands too — the small offshore areas are the ones most often left fogged — and check the map between sweeps to see which patches are left.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: gang operations stay available after the story.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total, and 100% completion needs all 39, so this trophy pops early on the way to the full set. Operations are marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track them under Progress, then Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed, at the bottom right.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: the bar stays open after the story.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach and buy an Apple Martini. Drink it while standing next to the bar, with the view in front of you, and the trophy pops. A quiet, cheap trophy — do it whenever you are passing Ocean Beach. The name is a nod to the very first GTA, where the opening line was 'In the beginning…' — a fitting first easy trophy for a guide that starts at the beach.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: the showroom and the car stay there after the story.
trophies.guide: Steal a specific car from a specific showroom and drive it out through the window. The car is the blue Banshee in the showroom in the south of Vice City, and it only unlocks after you get the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs (steal the Zorrusso for Randy). Hack into the Banshee, drive forward and straight through the showroom window. The pop is slightly delayed — it triggers after you drive further away on the street. Only this blue Banshee works, no other car; it is an easter egg reference to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable: if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns and you can return for the remaining valuables.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, one of the gang operations in Port Gellhorn. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which is marked automatically. Before going, buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation — you need them to blow the safe. Inside the bowling alley, pick up the 3 valuables: the luxury watch in the office in the south-east (golden icon), the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner (golden icon), and the safe in the office in the north-east hallway — blow it up with sticky bombs. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item, and killing the enemies is not necessary. If you do not get all 3 during the mission, wait until the robbery icon respawns and go back for the rest — you do not need them all in one go.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: gyms stay open after the story.
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check a character's strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, select the character and scroll to Strength (the heart icon). You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Raise strength by working out — buy a membership at a fitness club and always go together with both characters (hold Right and press Triangle to call your partner): while you actively work out with one character, the other automatically completes their training too, so you make double progress. Filter for fitness clubs on the map under Activities (the dumbbell icon); there are plenty all over Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: profile actions can be repeated any time; just avoid the permanent Irredeemable profile.
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile — the PSN tracker counts up to 500, and you can watch the number by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. Turn on criminal profile notifications first (Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile = On): whenever you do something that affects your reputation, a little demon face appears on the right of the screen. Actions push your profile through Professional (finishing objectives and robberies stealthily, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating enemies without killing them), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, or driving over gravestones) and finally Irredeemable — a permanent status if you keep using excessive violence, so avoid that one, since cops will shoot you on sight more often. You will very likely reach 500 passively while working on the other trophies and the 100% checklist, since every robbery and enemy encounter counts. If you are still short at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: the store can be robbed again at any time after the prologue.
trophies.guide: During the prologue, Lucia robs a Payday Loans store. This trophy is for going back later in the game and robbing the same store again as Lucia — recreating what you did in the prologue — then getting away on foot, not in a vehicle. Head to the store as Lucia, rob it, and run clear on foot until the trophy pops. If it does not pop, check that you are playing as Lucia and that you left on foot: driving away is the usual reason it fails.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: the UFO easter egg can be attempted again on later nights.
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2 AM, and come alone — no partner. The sighting is slightly random and not a guaranteed spawn, so if nothing happens, leave and try again on another night. When the UFO event triggers, the trophy pops. The name is a nod to The X-Files — the classic UFO-hunting line fits a trophy that is all about standing in the right place at the right hour and waiting for the sky to do something strange.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: melee drive-bys can be done any time in free-roam.
trophies.guide: Knock people over with melee attacks from a moving bike. The reported method: ride a motorbike or bicycle through a crowded area — Ocean Beach and busy Vice City streets have plenty of people — and press Square to kick pedestrians as you pass, aiming for 10 kicks within 60 seconds. This one is still unconfirmed by the big guides (PowerPyx only notes it is believed to be about kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle), so treat the kick count as a reported method, not a verified one, and keep trying if it does not pop at first.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: marked bills keep coming from robberies after the story.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew) — that unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total counts across all robberies, so you do not need $250,000 at once. This comes naturally while doing all robberies for the 100% checklist — bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery within a few minutes, once they unlock after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is….

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: shops stay open after the story.
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. Leonida has plenty of places to spend — 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores. This climbs on its own while you gear up for the other trophies; if you are short at the end, buy the priciest weapon mods and car parts.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: garages stay for sale after the story.
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages, for a total of $160,000. (The 4 story-related garages do not count.) Garages become available for purchase after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses) — you get a notification that a new app, Vice City Real Estate, has been installed on your phone, and you buy the garages through that app. A quick way to make the money is robberies, especially in Chapters 3-4 when higher-value robberies unlock.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.missable_note: Cannot be missed: vehicles keep spawning after the story.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses) — it lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location. To register a vehicle, drive it to Moses in Port Gellhorn and, in his garage, choose Respray and then Register. You need enough garages first (see Little Boxes), since each garage adds parking spots for registered vehicles. At first Moses only accepts vehicles without trackers; later, in Chapter 3, you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep expenses down.
